mentions.name: FoldRoute
mentions.description: A progressive web app (PWA) route planner for folding bikes that plans trips combining biking with public transport. Currently German-only and PWA-only (with stated plans to translate to English and possibly ship native Android/iOS apps), with navigation noted as still needing real-world testing.
mentions.problem: There was no good route planner for combining biking with public transport, a gap the author noticed after buying a Brompton folding bike.
mentions.audience: Folding bike riders who combine cycling with public transport
mentions.source_excerpt: FoldRoute - a PWA route planer for folding bikes & public transport
